shortDescription: Create or remove a Distributed Switch

options.name: contact
options.description: Dictionary which configures administrator contact name and description for the Distributed Switch.

options.name: datacenter_name
options.description: The name of the datacenter that will contain the Distributed Switch. Required if O(folder) is not provided. Mutually exclusive with O(folder) parameter.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the Distributed Switch.

options.name: discovery_operation
options.description: Select the discovery operation. Required if O(state=present).

options.name: discovery_proto
options.description: Link discovery protocol between Cisco and Link Layer discovery. Required if O(state=present). V(cdp): Use Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP). V(lldp): Use Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP). V(disabled): Do not use a discovery protocol.

options.name: folder
options.description: Destination folder, absolute path to place dvswitch in. The folder should include the datacenter. Required if O(datacenter) is not provided. Mutually exclusive with O(datacenter) parameter. Examples:    folder: /datacenter1/network    folder: datacenter1/network    folder: /datacenter1/network/folder1    folder: datacenter1/network/folder1    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/network    folder: folder1/datacenter1/network    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/network/folder2

options.name: health_check
options.description: Dictionary which configures Health Check for the Distributed Switch.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: mtu
options.description: The switch maximum transmission unit. Required if O(state=present). Accepts value between 1280 to 9000 (both inclusive).

options.name: multicast_filtering_mode
options.description: The multicast filtering mode. V(basic) mode: multicast traffic for virtual machines is forwarded according to the destination MAC address of the multicast group. V(snooping) mode: the Distributed Switch provides IGMP and MLD snooping according to RFC 4541.

options.name: net_flow
options.description: Dictionary which configures the Net Flow for the Distributed Switch.

options.name: network_policy
options.description: Dictionary which configures the different default security values for portgroups. If set, these options are inherited by the portgroups of the DVS.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: If set to V(present) and the Distributed Switch does not exist, the Distributed Switch will be created. If set to V(absent) and the Distributed Switch exists, the Distributed Switch will be deleted.

options.name: switch_name
options.description: The name of the distribute vSwitch to create or remove.

options.name: switch_version
options.description: The version of the Distributed Switch to create. The version must match the version of the ESXi hosts you want to connect. The version of the vCenter server is used if not specified. Required if O(state=present).

options.name: uplink_prefix
options.description: The prefix used for the naming of the uplinks. Only valid if the Distributed Switch will be created. Not used if the Distributed Switch is already present. Uplinks are created as Uplink 1, Uplink 2, etc. pp. by default.

options.name: uplink_quantity
options.description: Quantity of uplink per ESXi host added to the Distributed Switch. The uplink quantity can be increased or decreased, but a decrease will only be successfull if the uplink isn't used by a portgroup. Required if O(state=present).

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
